text:
Alex: uploaded a quick Figma of the compare table at 3 density levels. major issue — performance badges push the version pin off the row at smallest density. screenshot: https://figma.redwood/example.png
Marcy: can you paste the small/medium/compact screenshots inline? hard to eyeball from a single link
Alex: pasted below (compact / medium / comfy). compact is what we ship to customers by default for large catalogs.
Devin: my 2¢ — badges are valuable but they should be visually separable from the pin affordance. maybe move badges into a right-aligned cell so pin never overlaps?
Priya: accessibility nit: the pin needs an explicit aria-pressed state and a visible focus ring. Keyboard users can’t tell if a version is pinned when density is tight.
Jordi: agree with Priya. Also, badge text truncation is weird: we show `p50 23ms · cost $0.003` and it cuts mid-word. Suggest limit to 2 badge lines or switch to icon + tooltip on hover.
Sam: +1 to icon + tooltip. For compact we could collapse performance badges to an icon (chart line) and expand on hover. keeps rows short.
Alex: prototype idea: add a compact mode toggle at top of catalog so teams can opt into density. default stays medium. Also add an option in compare view: "preserve pinned column" which creates a fixed column for pinned versions.
Marcy: love the preserved pinned column — fewer surprises for users. Question: does that break responsive on mobile?
Devin: on mobile the compare becomes a stacked view, so pinned column can become sticky header in stacked mode. need to mock.
Priya: copy tweak: current tooltip says `Pin version`. change to `Pin version for this comparison` — more explicit. Also for screen reader announce: "Version 1.2 pinned" after action.
Jordi: contrast check: performance badges use #5A6 on green which fails AA at small text. we should either tweak color or add a 1px dark outline.
Sam: performance metric suggestions: surface p50 latency, tokens/sec, and an indicator if quantized. small icons for each to save space.
Alex: quick CSS snippet I tried in staging to clamp badge width: ```css
.compare-row { min-height: 40px; }
.compare-row .badges { max-width: 96px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.pin { position: sticky; right: 8px; }```
Marcy: sticky pin is interesting but sticky in tables can be flaky across browsers. file a browser-compat ticket if we go this route.
Devin: UX question: when you pin a specific model version, do we lock that row to that version in all comparisons for that session? or just the current view? needs product decision.
Alex: proposal: pin is view-scoped by default, with a small banner "Pinned versions saved to this comparison" and an opt-in to persist pins to user prefs.
Priya: also add keyboard shortcut `p` when row focused to toggle pin. update docs.
Jordi: can we run a quick A/B: default medium vs compact with badge-collapse on for compact. measure pin misclicks and time to find pin.
Sam: +1. I can hook up an analytics event `catalog.pin_toggled` and `catalog.badge_collapsed` — will set up in tracking board.
Alex: ui-bot: preview deployed to staging at https://staging.redwood/catalog-compare (build #452). please validate keyboard + screen reader flows. :rocket:
ui-bot: deploy note: staging build 452 includes compact toggle + badge-collapse feature flag `catalog.compact_badges` (off by default).
Marcy: next actions: Alex to update mock for sticky-pinned column fallback, Priya to write accessibility checklist, Sam to add analytics events, Devin to write compatibility ticket for sticky cells. I'll sync on Mon. :calendar:
